title: 15 Work From Home Sales Jobs in India 2026: Pay and How to Start
summary: Telecaller, inside sales and commission roles, pay seen in real listings, target traps, and how to start.
body_markdown:
Work from home sales jobs let you sell products or services by phone, video, WhatsApp or online from home, paid by fixed salary, commission or both. Common roles include selling financial products with GroMo, telecalling, inside sales, sales development and online reselling. Listings we checked show fixed pay of about ₹6,000 to ₹30,000 a month, plus commission of about 5% to 15% (job listings, retrieved 2026-11-06).


Below are 15 remote sales jobs in India, what each involves, the skills it needs and how to begin. Pay figures come from real job listings, so treat them as examples, and read the target terms carefully; some listings withhold fixed pay when you miss your target. New to selling? Start with[how to convince a customer](https://gromo.in/blog/how-to-convince-customer/) .

Starting-cost labels are our own rough estimates: None, Very low, Low and Medium. Actual costs depend on your city and setup.


How this list is ranked: GroMo comes first because it is free, has no targets and has no interview. The rest follow the remote sales roles that appear most often on Indian job boards, with the easiest to enter placed higher.


## 1. Selling Financial Products With GroMo: Bank-paid commissions, no stock


**Starting cost:** None | **Skills:** Basic phone use; free training in the app | **Best for:** Anyone 18 or older


Selling financial products with GroMo tops this list because it costs nothing to start and needs only a smartphone. GroMo is a free app where you help people apply for credit cards, savings accounts, loans and demat accounts from partner banks, and you earn a commission when the application is approved. On GroMo, credit cards pay up to ₹2,000, savings accounts up to ₹1,000, demat accounts up to ₹450, and personal loans up to 4.5% of the loan amount (GroMo catalogue, retrieved 2026-11-06). It is a commission-only sales role you run from home, with no targets or boss, and the free in-app training teaches each product before you sell it. The pay is commission only, with no fixed salary, and only approved applications earn; you must be 18 or older.


How to start:


1. Download the GroMo app and register free with your phone number.
2. Finish the one-time verification and the free in-app training.
3. Share a product link with someone who genuinely needs it, then track the application in the app.


## 2. Telecaller or Telesales Executive: Call leads from home


**Starting cost:** None | **Skills:** Clear speech, patience | **Best for:** Freshers and regional-language speakers


Telecalling is the most common remote sales job. One listing we checked paid ₹14,000 to ₹16,000 in hand plus incentives averaging about ₹6,000 a month (job listing, retrieved 2026-11-06), and another pays ₹6,000 a month on contract, so pay varies a lot.


How to start:


1. Check the company and get a written offer.
2. Ask about calling hours and targets.
3. Keep a quiet space and good headphones.


## 3. Inside Sales Executive: Sell over phone and video


**Starting cost:** None | **Skills:** Product knowledge, persuasion | **Best for:** People comfortable closing deals


Inside sales roles handle the full sale remotely, often for edtech, software or finance firms. One listing offered a ₹30,000 monthly base plus 5% commission (job listing, retrieved 2026-11-06), though that is at the higher end and may need experience.


How to start:


1. Learn how to run a sales call.
2. Apply to companies with remote sales teams.
3. Compare fixed pay, target and commission in writing.


## 4. Sales Development Representative: Book meetings for senior sales


**Starting cost:** None | **Skills:** Email, LinkedIn, phone | **Best for:** Freshers aiming for software sales


Sales development representatives find and qualify leads, then book meetings for senior salespeople. The role is common in software companies and is a good first step toward higher-paying enterprise sales.


How to start:


1. Learn basic cold email and LinkedIn outreach.
2. Apply to software and B2B companies.
3. Track your numbers to show in interviews.


## 5. Edtech Sales Counsellor: Sell courses to students and parents


**Starting cost:** None | **Skills:** Counselling, patience | **Best for:** Good communicators


Edtech counsellors call interested students and parents and explain courses. Check the targets carefully and never pressure anyone into a loan to pay for a course, because the customer's trust matters more than one sale.


How to start:


1. Ask about targets and how leads are provided.
2. Learn the course well before selling.
3. Be honest about fees and refunds.


## 6. Insurance Telesales: Sell policies by phone


**Starting cost:** None | **Skills:** Licensing or certification | **Best for:** People comfortable with finance


Insurance telesales roles sell policies over the phone, often through a broker or insurer. Selling insurance requires the training and certification that IRDAI rules set out, so join only through a licensed company.


How to start:


1. Check that the company is licensed.
2. Complete the required training.
3. Explain policy limits honestly.


## 7. Real Estate Pre-Sales Caller: Qualify property buyers


**Starting cost:** None | **Skills:** Local knowledge, calling | **Best for:** People in growing cities


Real estate pre-sales callers qualify people interested in projects and pass good leads to site teams. Many roles pay a fixed salary plus incentive per site visit or booking, so ask how often those bookings really happen.


How to start:


1. Apply to developers and brokers.
2. Learn the local market.
3. Confirm the incentive terms in writing.


## 8. Software Sales (SaaS): Sell tools to businesses


**Starting cost:** None | **Skills:** Business understanding, demos | **Best for:** Experienced or ambitious salespeople


Software sales is among the better-paid remote sales paths, selling tools to businesses through online demos. Entry usually comes through a sales development role, and English and business understanding help a lot.


How to start:


1. Learn what the software solves.
2. Start in a sales development role.
3. Practise demos and handling objections.


## 9. Affiliate Marketer: Commission on online sales


**Starting cost:** None | **Skills:** Content, audience | **Best for:** People with an online audience


Affiliate marketing is commission-only online selling through your own links. There is no boss or target, but income depends on building an audience you can sell to, which takes time.


How to start:


1. Pick one product area.
2. Join an affiliate programme.
3. Post honest reviews and disclose your links.


## 10. WhatsApp and Instagram Reseller: Sell to your own network


**Starting cost:** Low | **Skills:** Selling, customer service | **Best for:** People with a big social circle


Reselling through WhatsApp and Instagram is the simplest home sales business. You earn a margin on each sale, and taking payment before ordering from the supplier keeps your risk low.


How to start:


1. Choose one category friends already buy.
2. Share products daily, but don't spam.
3. Order only after the customer pays.


## 11. Lead Generation Freelancer: Find leads for businesses


**Starting cost:** None | **Skills:** Research, LinkedIn, spreadsheets | **Best for:** Careful researchers


Lead generation freelancers build lists of potential customers for businesses, often paid per verified lead. Only collect business contact details that you have the right to use, and follow data privacy rules.


How to start:


1. Learn lead research tools.
2. Take a small trial project.
3. Charge per verified lead.


## 12. Customer Success or Renewal Executive: Keep customers and upsell


**Starting cost:** None | **Skills:** Relationship building | **Best for:** Patient, helpful people


Customer success and renewal roles call existing customers to renew or upgrade, which is easier than cold calling. Many software, insurance and subscription companies hire for these roles remotely.


How to start:


1. Look for renewal or customer success roles.
2. Show examples of helping customers.
3. Ask how renewal incentives work.


## 13. Healthcare Sales Telecaller: Calls for health products and services


**Starting cost:** None | **Skills:** Polite, clear calling | **Best for:** Calm, careful speakers


Healthcare telecallers call people about clinics, diagnostic tests and health plans. Be careful never to make medical claims or give advice, and check the pay: one contract listing we saw paid just ₹6,000 a month (job listing, retrieved 2026-11-06).


How to start:


1. Check the company and the contract length.
2. Use only the approved script.
3. Don't give medical advice.


## 14. Loan or Credit Card Telecaller: Sell for a bank partner


**Starting cost:** None | **Skills:** Finance basics, calling | **Best for:** People interested in finance


Loan and credit card telecallers work for banks or their agencies, calling leads with a fixed salary and targets. Our guide to the[credit card sales job](https://gromo.in/blog/credit-card-sales-job/) compares this role with freelance selling.


How to start:


1. Apply through bank partner agencies.
2. Learn eligibility rules for the product.
3. Never promise approval to a customer.


## 15. Online Store Owner: Sell your own products


**Starting cost:** Medium | **Skills:** Store setup, marketing | **Best for:** People with a product idea


Running your own online store means you control prices and earn the full margin, but you also carry the marketing, stock and return costs. Start only after your product has sold well to real customers.


How to start:


1. Test demand with a small batch.
2. Set up a simple store.
3. Reinvest early profit in marketing.


## How Much Does GroMo Pay for Each Product?


Product on GroMo Pays partners up to


SBI Credit Card ₹2,000 per approved card


HDFC Secured Credit Card ₹1,750 per approved card


Axis Saving Account ₹1,000 per account


Digi Credit Personal Loan 4.5% of the loan amount


Kotak 811 Super Account ₹600 per account


Kotak Securities Demat Account ₹450 per account


The SBI Credit Card pays partners up to ₹2,000 per approved card (GroMo catalogue, retrieved 2026-11-06). Commission is paid only on approval.


The Axis Saving Account pays up to ₹1,000 per successful account (GroMo catalogue, retrieved 2026-11-06). Many other products pay less.


The Digi Credit Personal Loan pays up to 4.5% of the loan amount, and most other lenders pay less (GroMo catalogue, retrieved 2026-11-06). Check the live payout in the app.


## How much do work from home sales jobs pay?


Work from home sales jobs often pay a fixed amount of about ₹6,000 to ₹30,000 a month plus incentives, based on the job listings we checked (retrieved 2026-11-06). Commission is often 5% to 15% of sales. Those are employer-stated figures, not a survey, and big claims about what current staff earn should be treated with caution unless you see proof.


## Commission only or fixed salary: which is better?


A fixed salary suits you if you need regular monthly income, while commission only suits you if you have free time and a good network. Fixed-pay jobs bring targets and fixed hours. Commission-only work has no income guarantee, but it offers flexibility. Some listings withhold fixed pay if you miss your target, so read this clause first.


## What skills do you need for remote sales?


Remote sales needs clear communication, product knowledge, patience with rejection and honest follow-up. You can learn most of it on the job. Good salespeople listen first and recommend only what fits. Honest scripts beat pressure every time.


## How do you spot a fake sales job?


A fake sales job asks you to pay for a kit, training or a security deposit, or asks you to buy stock you must then sell. Genuine companies don't charge you to work. Check the company, ask for a written offer, and be careful with schemes that pay you mostly for recruiting other people. To see honest commission work, read[how to sell a credit card](https://gromo.in/blog/how-to-sell-a-credit-card/) .


**GroMo** is a free app where partners help customers apply for credit cards, loans, savings accounts and demat accounts from partner banks, and earn a commission on approval.


## FAQ: Work from Home Sales Jobs


### What are work from home sales jobs?


They are sales roles you do from home by phone, video, WhatsApp or online. Examples include telecalling, inside sales, reselling and selling financial products with GroMo.


### What is the salary of a work from home sales job?


Listings we checked show fixed pay of about ₹6,000 to ₹30,000 a month, plus commission or incentives. Your pay depends on the company, product and target.


### Is commission-only work from home real?


Yes, some is real, such as GroMo or affiliate marketing. But income isn't guaranteed. Avoid any scheme that charges you to join or pays mainly for recruiting people.


### Can freshers get remote sales jobs?


Yes. Telecalling, inside sales and sales development roles often hire freshers. Clear communication matters more than experience at entry level.


### Is GroMo a work from home sales job?


GroMo isn't an employer and pays no salary. It is a free app where you earn commission on approved applications, working from home in your own time.


### Do I need a licence to sell financial products from home?


That depends on the product. On GroMo, partner products are offered by regulated providers. Selling insurance or mutual funds independently has its own certification rules.


GroMo (Vitrak Technologies Pvt Ltd) is a distribution platform. GroMo isn't a bank, NBFC, insurer or investment adviser. All products are offered by their respective RBI, IRDAI or SEBI-regulated providers.


Partner earnings depend on effort, product mix and customer eligibility. Any figures shown are illustrative. They aren't typical and aren't promised.


Sources: Job listings checked on Qureos, Jobgether, Weekday, Cazvid and GrabJobs, and WorkIndia's salary range, retrieved 2026-11-06. GroMo product catalogue, commission rates by product, retrieved 2026-11-06.


## Disclaimer


GroMo doesn't promise any level of income. Commissions are set by partner banks, vary by product and campaign, and are paid only on approved applications; check the live commission in the GroMo app. Starting-cost labels are our own rough estimates, and any pay figures from other sites or job listings are what those sources state, not a guarantee. GroMo is available only to users aged 18 and above. Everything above is general information, not financial, legal or career advice.
